native.emptyDescription: Open Vibeset to add your calendar.

heroDescription: Find a look that feels like you. Wallpapers and a live calendar, together.
searchHint: Enter at least 2 characters to search.
emptyDescription: No published themes match yet. Try another search or refresh later.
savedDescription: Favorites stay on this device. No account is required.
savedEmpty: Save a theme with the heart to find it here.
savedUnavailable: Some saved themes are no longer available publicly.
favoriteLimit: You can keep up to 500 favorites on this device.
widgetApplied: Your calendar theme is ready. Add the Vibeset widget from the iPhone widget gallery.
widgetsDescription: A live date and calendar, styled with your chosen theme.
widgetsEmpty: Open a theme and choose “Use for my calendar” to begin.
widgetInstructions: Touch and hold the Home Screen, open its editing controls, then add Vibeset from the widget gallery. Control positions vary by iOS version.
widgetLanguageNote: The widget uses the language selected when you apply its theme. Apply it again after changing languages.
previewOnly: Preview. The installed widget follows the device date and updates on its timeline.
about: Made for a little everyday inspiration.
storageWarning: Your choices are available in this session, but could not be saved on this device. They may reset when the app closes.
invalidStorage: Saved preferences could not be read. The app is using defaults; you can save your choices again.
errorConfig: The catalogue service is not configured. Please contact support.
errorNetwork: We could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errorNotFound: This theme is no longer available.
errorResponse: The service returned content we could not read. Try again later.
errorHttp: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again.
errorPermission: Photos access was not granted. You can still use the share button.
errorMedia: We could not prepare this wallpaper. Please try again.
errorNoWallpaper: This theme does not have a downloadable phone wallpaper yet.
errorWidget: We could not update the calendar widget. Please try again.
errorLink: This link could not be opened. Please try again later.

startup.fontError: Could not load the app fonts.

readStorageWarning: We could not read your saved choices. Load them again before making changes.
reportDescription: Tell us about a problem with this theme. A report is sent only when you submit this form.
reportDetailsHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Do not include passwords, private photos or sensitive personal information.
reportSuccess: Your report was received for review. Thank you.
reportValidation: Choose a reason and check that your details use no more than 1,000 characters.
reportRateLimited: You have sent too many reports. Please try later, or contact support for an urgent concern.
reportDisabled: Reporting is temporarily unavailable. Contact support at ahmadalwakai@gmx.com.
reportForbidden: This report could not be accepted. Please contact support.
hideDescription: Hide this theme on this device. Restore hidden themes in Settings. This does not send a report.
blockDescription: Hide themes attributed to this creator in Explore, Saved and details on this device. A matching selected calendar theme will be cleared. Undo this in Settings. This does not send a report or ban the creator.
blockedDescription: These choices stay on this device and hide content with the matching creator handle. Content without an identified creator can be hidden individually.
noBlockedCreators: You have not hidden any creators.
restoreHiddenDescription: Restore all individually hidden themes on this device. Creator hiding stays in place.
contentHidden: This content is hidden on this device. Manage your choices in Settings.
hiddenPage: Items on this page are hidden by your preferences. Load more if available, or manage hidden content in Settings.
hiddenLimit: Your hidden-content preferences have reached their storage limit. Restore some content in Settings and try again.
errorHide: We could not hide this content or clear its selected widget. Please try again.
